description: Solaratlas Brandenburg, Eignung der Freiflächen für Agri-Photovoltaik is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data set contains the results of the potential analysis of usable areas for solar power plants in the state of Brandenburg (on behalf of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, Labour and Energy of the state of Brandenburg). The potentials for ground-mounted photovoltaic systems outside the EEG-eligible area are presented. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Solar Atlas Brandenburg, suitability of open spaces for agri-photovoltaics" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Energieagentur, Photovoltaikanlagen, Energie, Energieberatung, Potenzialanalyse, Erneuerbare Energie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
